title: Service Contracts: customer role and credit approval required for an offer
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product applies when a contract offer is issued. It governs which customers may be offered a tier, by their commercial role and their credit standing.

## Formal clauses
1. The customer's role must be one of the roles the tier allows.
2. When the tier requires credit approval, the customer's credit status must be credit approved.

Both conditions are checked before the offer is issued, against the line's customer record of the customer to whom the offer is issued. The role and the credit status are those recorded on that customer profile; the caller's own description of its role or credit standing does not take the place of the record.

## Role condition
| Customer role on the record | Role condition |
|---|---|
| one of the tier's allowed roles | met |
| not one of the tier's allowed roles | not met |

The recorded role is one of beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder or NVOCC.

## Credit condition (truth table)
| Tier requires credit approval | Credit status on the record | Credit condition |
|---|---|---|
| yes | credit approved | met |
| yes | cash in advance | not met |
| yes | credit hold | not met |
| no | any status | this clause sets no credit requirement |

## Points of judgement
**A customer on cash in advance asks for a tier that requires credit approval.** The credit condition is not met, because only a credit approved status satisfies it.

**The caller states that its credit has just been approved, but the profile still shows credit hold.** The condition is judged on the recorded credit status, which is credit hold, so it is not met.

**A tier does not require credit approval.** The credit clause then imposes nothing; the role condition still applies.
